prune.name: at the hard cap nothing is pruned
one over the hard cap prunes the middle
long window keeps first page, last page and fills toward the target
rows without created_at are never pruned and never counted
compression summaries are not normal rows
newest checkpoint wins, first of equals
checkpoint without a boundary prunes nothing extra
target below page limit is raised to it
page limit larger than the window keeps everything

preserve.name: incoming is a suffix of a longer window

merge.name: later page wins a duplicate id

timeline.name: explicit wins over legacy; first of each kind
assistant of an unknown user is ignored
system and tool rows are skipped
legacy scan stops at the next user
id of an assistant row is not a user
answered counts explicit plus legacy only

activity.name: children group under their root, root counted once
deep chain groups under the top root
missing parent makes the chat its own root
duplicate chat ids use the last record
empty parent id is no parent
ancestors of non-hidden branch beside hidden sibling
